# Ebn Sina

> Ebn Sina is a software engineer who builds complex infrastructure and developer
> products end to end — video infrastructure, CDN and edge delivery, analytics
> pipelines, media players, error-tracking and observability tools, e-commerce
> platforms, and learning platforms (LMS) — plus the platform engineering that
> keeps them fast and durable.
> He works across the stack: distributed systems that survive real traffic,
> frontends that don't make users wait, and the edge/caching layer beneath both.

Tools he reaches for most: Go, Rust, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, nginx/OpenResty.

- Name: Ebn Sina
- Role: Software Engineer

- GitHub: https://github.com/ebnsina
